institution.sr: Univerzitet „Union — Nikola Tesla” · Fakultet za graditeljski menadžment, Beograd

notice.en: Open a question on your phone. Predict, discuss, then test one change.
notice.sr: Otvori pitanje na telefonu. Predvidi, razgovaraj, pa proveri jednu promenu.

prompt.en: A sum starts at 0. We add 12, then 18, then 15. What is the state immediately after the second addition?
prompt.sr: Zbir kreće od 0. Dodajemo 12, zatim 18, pa 15. Koje je stanje odmah posle drugog sabiranja?

explanation.en: The second step starts at 12 and adds 18. The state becomes 30. The final value 45 belongs to the next step.
explanation.sr: Drugi korak kreće od 12 i dodaje 18. Stanje postaje 30. Završnih 45 pripada sledećem koraku.

transfer.en: Now start at 5. What changes after each step? Explain before running.
transfer.sr: Sada kreni od 5. Šta se menja posle svakog koraka? Objasni pre pokretanja.

title.en: Order is part of the design.

prompt.en: Start at (1,0). Translate +4 along x, then rotate 90° counterclockwise around the origin. Where is the point?
prompt.sr: Kreni iz (1,0). Pomeri +4 po x, pa rotiraj 90° suprotno kazaljci sata oko početka. Gde je tačka?

explanation.en: (1,0) → (5,0) → (0,5). Reversing the operations gives (4,1). This uses mathematical x/y coordinates.
explanation.sr: (1,0) → (5,0) → (0,5). Obrnut redosled daje (4,1). Koristimo matematičke x/y koordinate.

transfer.en: Rotate about a different origin. Which assumption changed?
transfer.sr: Rotiraj oko drugog početka. Koja pretpostavka se promenila?

prompt.en: A solid wall is 4000 × 3000 × 200 mm. Its volume is…
prompt.sr: Pun zid ima mere 4000 × 3000 × 200 mm. Njegova zapremina je…

explanation.en: Divide cubic millimetres by 1000³ = 1,000,000,000. Openings, layers and overlaps are not included in this rectangular model.
explanation.sr: Kubne milimetre delimo sa 1000³ = 1.000.000.000. Otvori, slojevi i preklopi nisu deo ovog pravougaonog modela.

transfer.en: Double only the thickness. Predict the volume, then check.
transfer.sr: Udvostruči samo debljinu. Predvidi zapreminu pa proveri.

prompt.en: A takes 2 time units. Then B takes 3 and C takes 1. B and C require the same single crane. With no overlap, the earliest finish is…
prompt.sr: A traje 2 jedinice vremena. Posle njega B traje 3, a C traje 1. B i C koriste istu jednu dizalicu. Bez preklapanja, najraniji kraj je…

explanation.en: A ends at 2. The crane then performs 3 + 1 units of work: finish 6. Ignoring crane capacity incorrectly allows both jobs to overlap and predicts 5.
explanation.sr: A završava u 2. Dizalica zatim radi 3 + 1: kraj je 6. Zanemarivanje kapaciteta dozvoljava preklapanje i predviđa 5.

transfer.en: Add a second crane. Is that the only possible bottleneck on a real site?
transfer.sr: Dodaj drugu dizalicu. Da li je ona jedino moguće usko grlo na stvarnom gradilištu?

title.en: Half the height is not half the work.

prompt.en: Our invented four-layer pyramid has 49, 25, 9 and 1 cells from bottom to top. After the bottom layer, what fraction of all cells is placed?
prompt.sr: Naša izmišljena piramida sa četiri sloja ima 49, 25, 9 i 1 ćeliju odozdo naviše. Posle donjeg sloja, koliki deo svih ćelija je ugrađen?

explanation.en: There are 84 cells in total. 49/84 ≈ 58.33%, but only one of four layers is complete. Cell count is not labour time. This is a teaching model, not a reconstruction of Giza.
explanation.sr: Ukupno ima 84 ćelije. 49/84 ≈ 58,33%, ali završen je tek jedan od četiri sloja. Broj ćelija nije vreme rada. Ovo je nastavni model, ne rekonstrukcija Gize.

transfer.en: Would every cell cost the same effort to lift? What data would we need?
transfer.sr: Da li svaka ćelija zahteva isti napor za podizanje? Koji podaci nam nedostaju?

title.en: A picture is not a property.

prompt.en: A rectangular BIM object looks like a wall. Can its picture alone prove its material, fire rating or verified as-built state?
prompt.sr: Pravougaoni BIM objekat izgleda kao zid. Može li samo slika dokazati materijal, požarnu otpornost ili potvrđeno izvedeno stanje?

choices.en: Yes, if the render is detailed
No; we need data and evidence
choices.sr: Ne; potrebni su podaci i dokazi

explanation.en: Geometry, semantic class, declared property and evidence are different layers. A convincing AI answer does not supply missing measurements or provenance.
explanation.sr: Geometrija, semantički tip, deklarisano svojstvo i dokaz su različiti slojevi. Uverljiv AI odgovor ne daje nedostajuće merenje ili poreklo.

transfer.en: Write the three missing questions you would ask before using the value.
transfer.sr: Napiši tri nedostajuća pitanja koja bi postavio pre upotrebe vrednosti.

description.sr: Fajl je dogovor o čitanju niza.

description.en: Name inputs, steps, outputs and stopping conditions.
description.sr: Imenuj ulaz, korake, izlaz i uslov zaustavljanja.

description.en: Identity, units, relationships and BIM semantics.
description.sr: Identitet, jedinice, veze i BIM značenje.

description.en: Assumptions, simulation and checking an AI proposal.
description.sr: Pretpostavke, simulacija i provera AI predloga.

description.en: What is allowed now, and what changes next?
description.sr: Šta je sada dozvoljeno i šta se sledeće menja?

description.en: Paths, dependencies, waiting and shared resources.
description.sr: Putevi, zavisnosti, čekanje i zajednički resursi.

description.en: A boundary, a subdivision, a packing problem.
Numerical precision and the limits of a structural model.
description.sr: Numerička preciznost i granice modela konstrukcije.

description.en: Data size, complexity, approximation and uncertainty.
description.sr: Veličina podataka, složenost, aproksimacija i neizvesnost.
